title: lachemilla glandulosa
intro: Lachemilla glandulosa, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rock Rose include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe wounds, reduce pain, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include phenolic compounds, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, as well as essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing.
